name: Raja
subject: "Death to Krishnamoorthi"
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.
Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.
A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.
I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.
Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.
A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.
And every single time, I have made the same choice.
Keep going.
Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.
This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.
Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch . Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.
Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.
Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect leaders who won't be intimidated — no matter what they face? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
They can scream all they want.
We are not slowing down.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC)

name: Dan Cox
subject: Your Property Tax bill
body:
Marylanders are receiving their property tax bill this week - and the sticker shock for most is no laughing matter. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/finishing-well-6755722?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
# Your Property Tax Bill Doesn't Have to be That High.
Dear ,

Many Marylanders received their property tax bill this week and the shocking rise in tax due for most is upsetting, if not angering. That's why today we launched our first TV ad also running on social media. [Watch it here](https://us.list-manage.com/Bx6zSQhZiUc?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) and on over 500 channels streaming.

Like two of our older married children, and many like them, so many young families and retirees alike are moving out of Maryland because it is unaffordable for so many. And Wes Moore signed the law to tax them on their way out!

According to research, Maryland is the highest assessment (100%) in the region; and, [Rich States, Poor States](https://us.list-manage.com/h890hmJNLnl?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) has shown that we are one of the highest taxed states in the Nation, ranking near the bottom at 42nd out of 50. But with [your help](https://us.list-manage.com/EP452hQN07n?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) we can change that and continue to reach all of Maryland with our TV ads to beat Wes Moore.

[CLICK AND ](https://us.list-manage.com/1K5G9KJYABz?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)[DONATE HERE TO HELP US WIN](https://us.list-manage.com/17ebrN1x2Sx?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).
| **State** | **Assessment Ratio** | **Effective Property Tax Rate*** | **Notes**
---|---|---|---
**Maryland** | **100% of assessed value** | **~0.92%** | Full market value assessment statewide.
Pennsylvania | Varies by county (predetermined ratios/common level ratios; generally not 100% of current market value) | ~1.26% | County assessment systems vary significantly.
Virginia | 100% of fair market value | ~0.78% | Localities set tax rates.
Delaware | Fractional assessment system (properties generally assessed using older base-year values with county-specific rates) | ~0.54% | Does not assess at current full market value.
West Virginia | **60% of appraised value** | ~0.51% | Constitutional 60% assessment ratio for real property.
Because Maryland taxes 100% of the _assessed_ value, Governor Moore and his tax assessment office unilaterally raised rates by about 20% for most Maryland homeowners last year simply by raising assessments \- a massive spike on unrealized gains. Now, approximately 30,000 homes are up for tax lien sale this year in our State, and nearly half of those are senior citizens in economically struggling areas such as Baltimore City, Prince George's County and throughout the State.

We can stop this fleecing of Maryland with your help. But it truly is time sensitive - I need your help now.

Sign up to help us win or if you can chip in to keep our ads running, please do. This is a race we can win, but we can't do it alone.

For Maryland,

[](https://us.list-manage.com/uxTSu6MJWKp?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Dan Cox

body:
Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
Donald Trump is demanding -- again -- that Congress pass the SAVE America Act (the latest version of the anti-voting SAVE Act). With the House set to pass it again this week, the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections, folks.

Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet on the impact of these bills:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, join these brave Senators today. Fuel our efforts to stop this dangerous legislation with $25 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071126_1&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=071126_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=071126_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=071126_1&amount=50]

We know the SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before the next election, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
If you missed it: This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071126_1&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=071126_1&amount=20]

# Sunday, July 12, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1862, President Abraham Lincoln signed a law establishing the [U.S. Army Medal of Honor](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb_GdCDbGEwKF096ostquy3RxB4HR4ZB9mxQ_n6V_YXtbnWPzvm6LldIOe33D9jQcaRlx7NmZMayBHrU79tBuEMteFBhLHWl223RUo-ttK3SS4CUX4tpgouIGvsGnbJTPw1yMrpZHUK0Af0Q-osfB1Bo5KC8NGH0GM3km-Teb9IqraS06tLFQV3AW5iiDWAgCiMxJKbSPSjtvGLML3pi6TxtTXYr81FF_0_oWej5PM8OytuIafe4IWN5dVvKQs-fVBhyFXqWQs__yb_nhgFyS7FdaafSHSE2xYXjTDmnOlph5H2DlH9h_KdCT6d_AgAA___f0HyJ) for noncommissioned officers and privates showing gallantry during the Civil War. In 1863, Congress extended eligibility to officers, recognizing their valor. Tang, the orange-flavored breakfast drink, captivated American kids in the 1960s with an assist from NASA astronauts. It fell out of favor in the United States, but the brand has enjoyed remarkable success internationally, as seen in today's [Whatever Happened To...](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OKiEYxvGrYTonfClYUJhzYrKFW21iOXmBF8HgMAvoxLvfzN7Cts-T_Ir_9TJdIOU03z7hgaaHMs24toy9Y518ubenXQrO0CoupXasLRZrJ075YUfVjvHJQ8rvSQ7eBESOYkDDlBZ6T7XkQzTKSa2OSrCg92CpdQ6FhuCZDA6ohCGZTaOKcUapYscx7NkRnAIdlAcJgUiKPvVSx3tJc48Y8ru8sI6uPIZsYu9LI-JE-Jnw87qu47s8-9Pi9m8LdBeJOL-I-P91vcV__uMb_Wmoxi9ryjm1gyKS3h6Q8i_Z_9ThZfhPAAAA__9DoHKr) section. In case you missed it, this week on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Amy broke down the five retirement mistakes that quietly derail people after the paycheck stops. A new Nationwide study found more than half of recent retirees regret how they planned, and the culprits usually aren't the ones you'd expect. From the luck of when the market turns to the quiet discomfort of spending your own savings, Amy walked through what trips people up and how to sidestep it before it costs you. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzzFuwyAUANDT4C0WfLAhA0PVyuqSDl2qTujbfGIiYiwgiXL7qr1CL_Ck93VyJ4wpbucPvJJtIbuNHjVRa1Scz5d6m_dMG9ZCey6NSl3zPDvgMB64PghwHmN6OtV5G4iAZEdWaCPNwI2CbrVqGGYcvRd-4UGH0YQF-QBaaanQoOii_dW4FiA41-LYh0EccdFogvaoMDDFyceWS3_JcWsrhfTMdyr9kq9dsmtre2XyhcHEYHrmW7v1MzGY3l8_V3lCc87fTE6NyTcwpivW74-YUqyjZoqfrxjTn9T-1b9b-AkAAP__a-9tqQ)! Today's sponsor, [Spot Pet Insurance](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp8Gb7EuF9s4A0OlyFu6dkQYLjERGAtw0rx9lb7Cv376dI50_tz13YQY9sdvk0g1n_VO7xqpNSra5Wc91yPTbmqhI5dGpW55XTUCTheQF47amRA_euic8kRIoiPF5SzmEeYBu02BA2FR4jhJkqPkk3NoOaAQ3vkJbBfUlwaSIweQ_Nr7kV-NlWb20pnBeDYAudBy6Z857G0jHz_5RaW3OXVRba0dlYlfDBeGSyV7FupT3unzPTBcjsJwWUeLVzlzS35gYjHHXyOYuHEQyHA6W9KJXDgTEzdKJsSuKHe8Q4yhTpIN8PiO_43tR5leCv8FAAD__69Qem0), is helping pet owners prepare for unexpected veterinary expenses with affordable coverage options that can provide reimbursement for covered accidents, illnesses, and more.
|

## Four Subpoenaed for Air Force One Report
The Trump administration [subpoenaed four _New York Times_ journalists](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8Gd0SAf3AKim3c3W23tMZmCJPFYMEkUd5-lV3tE9z6kz6dc359rV9AifLtJxzoOJQ146slZMa6-nJvj-0smKFVPEtlrC2WbVuNMpNUVmqzeqD0XofOu4BosO_QaTv386jmwXTRWT-BCTtob3cTBkQfRqX7uVdB-20aOnKfN2W10UpZfb2EUV9htzAH62GAIAaFnrjUy71Q5oghvcsT62UvR5dcZD6b6H8IswizcMRIKX02YZZYDvwICbMc6AmEWcbr1M9aS44oM77ku9TfkunAJu_lUTMkatzkf3EJVGUodUdZMkqqkCXHisDyXxJhlq46f74oJWqTFYO6HUB_CTr-VtKnM38CAAD__-_NjfU) on Friday, after a story that outlined the risks involved in flying the Qatar-gifted Air Force One plane that recently entered into service. The report questioned whether the new plane, a Boeing 747-8, had been ["retrofitted with sufficient security measures"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAURL8Gd0RwTQIuKF5Dl9duaV2HS0yEjQUkkf9-5dXu_sDWMzqaMx_X8YoxxfX-HxeyLeRxpXdN1BqV0edHfU5bphVroS2XRqXOeZpGEHDhQnMJo8eY9lF13gYioL4jK7XpzVkYBd1sB1BCDVoQkjZnhVoF43EYpj6ACaLvoj1oQkuQQmg5nMJZDnjTaIL2qDAwJcjHlsvpkePaZgppzy8qp1teumTn1rbK-n8MHAO37luu7YgYuAPMwAnNwEnJwD0rP_wYuBYXqvzXiv-IkucYGhWOsfCQy414Xum7yMB1xfrtHVOK9aKZEvcFY_pa0v5038vCZwAAAP__J4-ETQ) during the rush to get it in the air. The president [flew the new Air Force One to a NATO summit](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOke2-RkoXNwmXW67JRrsmeDIYNZMEuXtV-wrbHl0pKPzfV-36YYxxe3-H1dywnna6H0kEqEyhfw4nvOeacOj0J6LUDmWPM-T1bZXGpSxU8CYPlNbB8dElpqanIGhGTo9tLZeHEBnPHBviDWz19hbxn5uOAydN11TR3euaTDWaA1mvHBnRvSAA0PAFrlqNYUouVweOW6yEKdPflG5-LzWyS0i-1E1_yp7rewV9xPgrM5QJPpElb1Kea672j6iMBbFuXhSeSP1jYIlqgeJIuthHHDs0FBrNECwHmnsR4A28Gjq4sL-jinFo4eq1fcVY_r9IH8S93L2JwAA__8EKoIL) in Turkey last week. But he departed on Wednesday on one of the older-model Air Force One jets for a trip to England before switching to the newer plane for the flight home to Joint Base Andrews. The _New York Times_ reported that the switch had come [at the urging of the Secret Service](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAcxJ8GOwz-wUULiq-x26-90oD8WdkgGMA1vv3FS-4JrptkMjP5zddzfmoffHz91xuq6tIc8SwBa8U82_Quh9kTRl0y7ilXzGVNxszA4EGZpB3MVvtwzaKxyiEC8gZVJwc-9GwQ0KxK8N4ww-WDMxDD2EsrOFipR7M4No6m8epuY7KDjjHZja3ru1EvUg9OWi20I4Kh9TXl9p18rCu6cKUP5nZJWxPUWuteCP9HYCIwnefZLqbcFLdPYLolganmY9up9pm6lBekKSItuBzZ14v-YtJ3OnLUwZd6Z5qs7H76EHx5SCLYa9M-_MzWP331UfAdAAD___9jgC0). Another article indicated that the newer plane lacked some of the advanced security features of the older aircraft, including antimissile capabilities. Both reports cited anonymous sources.
## Most of US Faces Dangerous Heat This Week

**Whatever happened to Tang?** In 1957, General Foods cooked up a concoction of orange "flavor crystals" that the company named Tang. It hit shelves two years later as a vitamin-fortified instant breakfast drink, and almost nobody bought it. Then NASA came calling. The agency needed something lightweight, shelf-stable, and strong enough to mask the taste of recycled spacecraft water, and Tang fit the bill. When astronaut John Glenn sipped it aboard _Friendship 7_ in 1962, General Foods pounced, slapping launch pads on the canisters and sponsoring ABC's coverage of Apollo 8. Kids everywhere begged for "the astronaut drink." Here's one of [the early space commercials](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OKiEYxvGrYTonfClYUJhzYrKFW21iOXmBF8HgMAvoxLvfzN7Cts-T_Ir_9TJdIOU03z7hgaaHMs24toy9Y518ubenXQrO0CoupXasLRZrJ075YUfVjvHJQ8rvSQ7eBESOYkDDlBZ6T7XkQzTKSa2OSrCg92CpdQ6FhuCZDA6ohCGZTaOKcUapYscx7NkRnAIdlAcJgUiKPvVSx3tJc48Y8ru8sI6uPIZsYu9LI-JE-Jnw87qu47s8-9Pi9m8LdBeJOL-I-P91vcV__uMb_Wmoxi9ryjm1gyKS3h6Q8i_Z_9ThZfhPAAAA__9DoHKr), and [here's a later one](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1q6zAYxvGrkbYYfTmyBw0HDllKCoW0HcUr61WsIFtGUmJy9yW9ha7PA7_h_322Z4gprtd3WNC0kO2Ke03YGhbr863e3ZZxhVpwy6VhqXN2zgomjgemD1xYDzE9raLeBESBkqLhepBDzwYl6Gw0jFo6DtxzqZzm_ejA61H1EwSvAqfRvDSmueCMaT52oecjTBqGoD0oCEQx9LHl0t1yXNuMIT3zA0s35YUmM7e2VSL_EXEi4rTve_fM93Z3-PpfC7RpJvL0IPL_x-VT1bev5XLMtBi_7TGlWI-aKHZdIKZfsv2pw8OInwAAAP__2AtyDQ). But what goes up must come down, and by the late 1980s, parents were reaching for Capri Sun pouches and juice boxes, and Tang, packing 29 grams of sugar a glass, started gathering dust. A late 90s [orangutan mascot couldn't save it](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGngS0WHIhxBoYr3UQZmg5dOiIMh5iIGAtILL995b5C1--TfsP_-2ZuNqY43z_tE3UL2cy41oStYTE-P-prXDLOthZccmlY6pTH0QCD_sDUgYPxNqbNSOp1QAQUFDVXgxiObJBAJx08KN9z2R8Vk8iAcT46iwGccGLggUa9a0xx4IwpfurCkZ-sU3YIyltpA5EMfWy5dI8c5zZhSFt-Y-lcftKkp9aWSsQ_AhcCl3Vduy2_2mvE_d8X29xExOVNxP_-4_zlT9cZr2datF_WmFKsvSKS3Z82pl-y_anDW8NPAAAA__-GWXGF). But here's the twist: while Americans moved on, the rest of the world didn't. Tang shifted its focus to developing markets, and by 2011, it was a [billion-dollar global brand](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSgyAQgOGnwU5nWTVoQXGNXa690llhiWSIOEDC5O1vcq9w_T9f8f9c1yv54I_bNz1YFxfXg2sOXAqn1cZ7fm5n5INy4jOmwinvcdtWBLy0oFqJqyUf3uvQWO2YkfuGtVRTP40wDdjs2m52Vmx6kPNIYNDMsIFzYy8N9HaUjdcfDZRECaDk3LlRzmQUTU5ZGsiJAdj6ElN3j_4oO7vwji9OnYmPJui9lDOL_kvgInCptXZmj3WPz8N-CoGLVAqmyyhw8bktdNzaXHwILaVPJHBpkrZn9SH4fFFigNuDfPjjy7-evDT-BgAA__8Bp3W6), fueled by Brazil, Argentina, the Philippines, and the Middle East, where more than half of annual sales happen in the six weeks around Ramadan. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. Both engines on a business jet flamed out on final approach to Laredo, forcing the crew to crash-land on a highway, a preliminary [National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) report](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O4zAMBeDT2J0CkVakqHCxjbvZdkuDluixdugfSEo8uf0i2SNMSRB4D9_78zF-UJK0ff6mlfv6Pe_jxmcRrpXz-Hcvy50m4hwylSXzseeaWXhEjVZppwDHSEmeo2ljP-nooeUe3K27XQ0Y2y797GIXGHyY55nRsGV9DUQwO2NR-2ub-leYdoAAGtFcEKyLQRvjJujA-sZojqnu-VIXrvxNZZbn_uB8CfvaSr_UepSm-9Xg0OBwnufl63Hn17PBgXJNQbjB4eVqcJA9kLzOWiZ1ZJa0po3yU_3XKaHMcVfvHnUIbazeePWVRDgqupeaNjXdS9q4lJW2Bge0XkVnonFTp9gDKAPeK28DKbg5jhDijbRpcx-PM4mkYl1j9OdKSd6M-rPxHz3-CwAA___dW5lm) released Friday found. The NetJets-operated jet was flying from Los Cabos, Mexico, to Austin on June 16 when the crew noticed an "unusual vibration." Warnings of low fuel pressure and cascading failures followed as it neared the border. Cleared to divert to Laredo International, the jet lost its right engine on approach and then its left. A controller said their only option was "the main highway," and they set down on Loop 20, shearing light poles and hitting a pickup. The crash killed [Joshua Baer](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHS2yAMgJ8Gb8ohmZpk8NDF29-1o08EOSbFkAPyO3n7ntNH6KzT90nf76_5i0MM6faLNxnba8lzkr1GaU3KfM91fbJjKdfCdS3yyKUViTKTpgG0BaTZc4jv2XR-dNpfsJMR7bk__zBohm4dDaMT78Xbfjl711tEvvBAbuGBNLoujAdMWyRETWROhIP1V22MddjjcFFGiw8tl1NbpcmL6xLf-VvK6Zq3Lo5ra4-q-p-KJkXTvu-nP5XbMVQ0Hd8omj5riqZDpWjSVtGEqGhyua0g6RaSVFgib-IhPxs4WXIRqBvHCHdp8CkgHkKC-zMJ5AQfKKzhtu78htSqg3-JoPL7sHVl9I89xBjqYJXRt41D_Fzd_q_190h_AwAA__80PJSL), the Austin entrepreneur who founded Capital Factory. Five others survived, though the pilot was seriously hurt.
